Ahmad Faruqui is an economist known for his work in the fields of utility regulation and animal welfare economics. His research often focuses on issues related to electricity pricing, economic regulation, and the welfare of animals. Faruqui has worked with various organizations and utilities, providing expertise on pricing strategies and market structures. He has also written extensively on the economic implications of regulatory policies.

Faruqui has contributed to discussions on how to balance the needs of consumers, utilities, and regulators, and he has worked on studies related to demand response and energy efficiency. His work has gained recognition in both academic and policy-making circles.

Beyond academia, he is involved in consulting and has advised public agencies, international organizations, and private firms. His insights are often utilized in creating more efficient and effective utility pricing models.

For the latest and most detailed information, I recommend checking recent publications or articles featuring Ahmad Faruqui, as developments in his work may have occurred since my last knowledge update.
